arxiv-2111-07646.title: Multimodal Generalized Zero Shot Learning For Gleason Grading Using Self-Supervised Learning
arxiv-2111-07646.creator: Dwarikanath Mahapatra
arxiv-2111-07646.description: Abstract Gleason grading from histopathology images is essential for accurate prostate cancer (PCa) diagnosis. Since such images are obtained after invasive tissue resection quick diagnosis is challenging under the existing paradigm. We propose a method to predict Gleason grades from magnetic resonance (MR) images which are non-interventional and easily acquired.

arxiv-2203-10389.title: On m-quasi-ideals in m-regular ordered semigroups
arxiv-2203-10389.creator: Susmita Mallick
arxiv-2203-10389.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Susmita Mallick. In this paper we characterize left(right) ideals, bi-ideals and quasi-ideals of an ordered semigroup by an index m m and give some important interplays between these ideals. The concept of m-regularity of an ordered semigroups has been introduced.

arxiv-2311-02773.title: Actions on the quiver – Discrete quotients on the Coulomb branch
arxiv-2311-02773.creator: Amihay Hanany, Guhesh Kumaran, Chunhao Li, Deshuo Liu, Marcus Sperling
arxiv-2311-02773.description: Abstract This paper introduces two operations in quiver gauge theories. The first operation takes a quiver with a permutation symmetry 𝔖 n \mathfrak{S}_{n} and gives a quiver with adjoint loops. The corresponding 3d 𝒩 = 4 {\cal N}=4 Coulomb branches are related by an orbifold of 𝔖 n \mathfrak{S}_{n} .

arxiv-2502-19436.title: Multiscale numerical methods for isothermal fluid models of confined plasmas
arxiv-2502-19436.creator: Chang Yang, Fabrice Deluzet
arxiv-2502-19436.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Chang Yang, Fabrice Deluzet. The aim of this work is to introduce a numerical method to cope with the multiscale nature of confined plasma physics. These investigations are focused on fluid plasma description under large magnetic field. The difficulties in this context stem from intense magnetization of the plasma, inducing a severe anisotropy, possible quasi-neutrality breakdowns, which may occur locally in the plasma and, eventually, the drift regime which prevails for the description of the electrons.

arxiv-2505-24116.description: Abstract In order for a humanoid robot to perform loco-manipulation such as moving an object while walking, it is necessary to account for sustained or alternating external forces other than ground-feet reaction, resulting from humanoid-object contact interactions. In this letter, we propose a bipedal control strategy for humanoid loco-manipulation that can cope with such external forces.

pmc-11306776.title: Governing of the piezoelectric effect by external fields and strains
pmc-11306776.creator: A A Zvyagin, V V Slavin
pmc-11306776.description: Piezoelectricity in quantum rare-earth metallic boron oxides with the coupling between magnetic, electric and elastic subsystem is studied theoretically. It is proved that the change of piezoelectric modules of the considered crystals are proportional to components of the quadrupole susceptibility, which determines the external magnetic and electric fields, strain and temperature dependences of that change.

pmc-12356972.title: ARHGAP4/MYH9/β-catenin/c-Jun positive feedback loop promotes colorectal cancer stemness
pmc-12356972.creator: Shaolin Liu, Yizhen Chen, Song Tan, Yifan Chen, Changshun Yang, Yulong Mi, Shengtao Lin, Weihua Li
pmc-12356972.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Rho GTPase-activating protein 4 (ARHGAP4) is implicated in poor prognosis across multiple malignancies. However, its role in driving stemness in colorectal cancer (CRC) remains unclear. In this study, we demonstrate that ARHGAP4 drives CRC stemness through a positive feedback loop involving MYH9/β-catenin/c-Jun, as validated by integrated bioinformatics analysis, in vitro and in vivo tumor stemness assays, co-immunoprecipitation, chromatin immunoprecipitation, and fluorescence recovery after photobleaching.

pmc-12748104.title: Navigating the Map of Environmental-policy Narratives and its Influence within the Conservation Network of the Colombian-Peruvian Amazon
pmc-12748104.creator: Carlos Eduardo González-Rodríguez, Oscar Buitrago-Bermúdez, Carolina Gonzalez, Johana Marcela Castillo-Rivera, Jean-Francois Le Coq
pmc-12748104.description: The Colombian-Peruvian Amazon’s global socio-ecological relevance attracts multiple organizations and technologies related to cooperation and environmental governance, configuring a complex network of interactions, relationships, and relational structures. This case study seeks to provide clarity on the complex functioning of the cooperation network in the Amazon biome, composed of institutional and technological nodes.

pmc-12800163.title: Role of the channel on the memory window of HfZrOx ferroelectric field-effect transistors with p-type Si-doped InZnOx channel
pmc-12800163.creator: Hyoungjin Park, Seokjae Lim, Somi Lee, Jae Woo Lee, Jiyong Woo
pmc-12800163.description: To elucidate the origin of the memory window (MW) of HfZrOx ferroelectric field-effect transistors (FeFETs) with a p-type Si-doped InZnOx (p-Si:InZnO) channel, we perform a comparative study with thin-film transistors (TFTs) in which the HfZrOx ferroelectric layer (FL) of the FeFETs is replaced by an HfO2 dielectric layer (DL).

pmc-13362668.title: Longitudinal Changes in Serum Procalcitonin After Bariatric Surgery and Their Associations with Anthropometric, Metabolic, and Inflammatory Parameters †
pmc-13362668.creator: Gurbet Ünal Özen, Çağrı Büyükkasap, Beyza Dursun, Aslı Akyol
pmc-13362668.description: Objective: Obesity is a systemic disease characterized by low-grade chronic inflammation and increased metabolic risk. pmc-13586435.title: Association of Vitamin D Status With Total and Site‐Specific Cancer Mortality From Tropical to Subantarctic Latitudes: A Nationwide Population‐Based Study in Chile
pmc-13586435.creator: Gonzalo Muñoz, Juan Pablo Fraga, Ignacia S. Núñez‐Ulloa, Alvaro Passi‐Solar, Bruno Nervi, Sebastián Mondaca, Paula Margozzini, Carlos A. Camargo, Arturo Borzutzky
pmc-13586435.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundAn association of low vitamin D (VD) status with increased cancer mortality has been described, and Chile provides an ideal setting to evaluate this association given its extensive latitude span (17°S–56°S).MethodsWe performed a nationwide population‐based ecological study of all and specific cancer deaths from 2002 to 2020, in which mean 25(OH)D concentrations were obtained from the 2017 Chilean National Health Survey and associations with cancer deaths were assessed across 48 provinces.
